tools.name: list_recent_items
tools.description: Lists the public items of the OSNT.IN daily briefs from the last 14 days (the first three of each brief, as a signed-out reader sees them; every item with an OSNT.IN Pro key), newest first: each item's title, date, every source it cites (name and link) and its page on app.osnt.in. No item text: open

tools.name: get_item
tools.description: Gets one OSNT.IN daily-brief item by its id, the 12 characters after /c/ in an app.osnt.in/c/ link: its title, date, every source it cites (name and link) and its page. No item text. An item removed in a correction says so. We attribute, we don't verify. Free use requires naming OSNT.IN with a link

tools.name: get_public_brief
tools.description: Gets the latest OSNT.IN daily brief as a signed-out reader sees it on app.osnt.in: the date, the summary and the public headlines, each with its link. Items for subscribers are left out, as on the site. We attribute, we don't verify. Free use requires naming OSNT.IN with a link (https://www.osnt.in

tools.name: get_weekly
tools.description: Gets the title, date and link of the latest OSNT.IN weekly report published on www.osnt.in. We attribute, we don't verify. Free use requires naming OSNT.IN with a link (https://www.osnt.in or the item's own link).

tools.name: get_methodology
tools.description: Explains in a few lines how OSNT.IN makes its briefs, with a link to read more. We attribute, we don't verify. Free use requires naming OSNT.IN with a link (https://www.osnt.in or the item's own link).
